purpose: Rendered browser scenarios for the Scopeify demo. These are used to exercise actual form submission, report/tab rendering, and browser-side file scanning across realistic project questions and edge cases.

scenario_sources.name: NCBI GEO DataSets
scenario_sources.basis: GEO DataSets is searchable by keywords, organism, dataset type, authors, Series, and Platform records. It is the main source for expression-reuse scenarios.

scenario_sources.name: NCBI Gene Expression Omnibus
scenario_sources.basis: GEO accepts array- and sequence-based functional genomics data and supports query/download workflows.

scenario_sources.name: NCBI Sequence Read Archive
scenario_sources.basis: SRA is the raw high-throughput sequencing archive used for reprocessing, reproducibility, and accession/run metadata scenarios.

scenario_sources.name: European Nucleotide Archive
scenario_sources.basis: ENA provides cross-archive nucleotide sequencing records and raw read metadata, useful for accession mirror checks.

scenario_sources.name: ENA Advanced Search documentation
scenario_sources.basis: ENA documents programmatic examples that can seed future automated search tests.

scenario_sources.name: bioRxiv API
scenario_sources.basis: bioRxiv exposes preprint metadata and publication linkage, useful for preprint and recent-evidence scenarios.

scenario_sources.name: NGDC Genome Sequence Archive
scenario_sources.basis: GSA archives raw sequence reads and public metadata, useful for China-archive search and negative-search logging scenarios.
